cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I set a spoon beside yours. Yesterday's measure. I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's for tea. How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tea first, yes. Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies a tea spoon as time currency; A3 covers B2's ordinary tea explanation and supplies time, then A5 covers B4's date correction with maturation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's how question leads A3 to wasted minutes; B4's today objection is precisely what overnight waiting resolves.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants a usable payment and B4 checks the offered unit, participating sensibly in the negotiation.

heightening.evidence: A5 develops B4's objection by treating time as currency that must age, preserving the original repair bargain.
